interpretation: More than one third of locally permissive target classifications were analyst-world contingent in the frozen panel.

The environmental-autocorrelation conclusion reversed sign across response-independent traversability rules, showing that the analyst translation from environmental difference to edge traversability can dominate the qualitative conclusion.
The barrier-density effect remained positive under all three analyst rules, providing an example of a conclusion robust to analyst uncertainty.
Expanding the analyst-world universe gained possible targets and eroded q70-only robust certificates with zero monotonicity violations.
The original EOG distinction between natural-world uncertainty and analyst-world uncertainty is therefore operationally measurable in known-truth landscapes.
claim_boundary: The three analyst rules are sensitivity worlds, not estimates of one true ecological threshold.
The v2 G2 hypothesis remains refuted; v3 explains rule sensitivity but does not reclassify it.
The 36.6 percent contingent fraction is a property of this frozen generator and rule set, not an ecological prevalence estimate.
